source: for adjusting the focus..., for admitting different amounts of light, and for the correction of spherical and chromatic aberration
lost: A three-item list (with a two-item list inside it) is one phrase in the source but needs four separate sentences, because no particle joins phrases.
fix: Coordinator AND usable between phrases and between blocks (parallel to OR).

source: the eye, with all its inimitable contrivances
lost: The phrase works as a concession inside the subject (despite having all these), but can only be stated as separate plain facts.
fix: Allow relation particles (CONCEDE, CAUSE) to introduce a modifier block on a phrase.

lost: The source means the eye as a kind of organ; a bare root or a handle does not say whether one eye, some eyes or the kind is meant.
fix: Quantifier-slot particle GENERIC for kind reference.

source: could have been formed / can be shown to exist / could be formed
lost: Possibility inside an embedded clause has no particle, since strength markers sit only at sentence level and mean the writer's confidence.
fix: Modal slot after time inside the clause: CAN, MUST, MAY.

lost: The writer's aside about his own statement must become a separate sentence pointing at the step.
fix: Attitude particle ADMIT.

source: absurd in the highest possible degree
lost: Extreme degree of a property cannot be marked; sentence-level EMPHASIS is not the same claim.
fix: Degree slot before a predicate or modifier: SLIGHT, VERY, MOST, ENOUGH, TOO.

source: one very imperfect and simple ... vary ever so slightly
lost: The intensifiers 'very' and 'ever so' are dropped; only the bare property or manner root survives.
fix: Same degree slot as above.

lost: The spec does not say whether a sentence marked CONCEDE is the conceded point or the point that holds anyway, so the direction of 'yet' is uncertain.
fix: Define each relation's direction in the spec (for example: CONCEDE n = sentence n is granted, this sentence holds anyway).

lost: Vague large quantity is not a quantifier and has to be a KIND modifier, which reads as a kind of gradation.
fix: Quantifiers MANY, FEW, MOST.

source: each grade being useful to its possessor
lost: Pairing each grade with its own possessor needs EACH from the logic section, which the body grammar does not admit in ordinary clauses.
fix: Add EACH handle IN phrase block to the body rule.

source: if ...; if further ...; and if ..., then
lost: Several joint conditions must be nested as IF inside IF five deep, hiding that they are parallel.
fix: AND block block, usable as an IF condition.

lost: Emphasis on one embedded clause cannot be marked because EMPHASIS belongs to the whole sentence.
fix: Allow attitude particles at the start of a block.

lost: The writer asserts as certain two clauses that sit inside an if-condition; an embedded block cannot carry an opener or strength, nor be referred to by label, so the clauses must be repeated in new sentences or the reader takes them as merely hypothetical.
fix: Allow a label on a block so a later sentence can say RECALLED CERTAIN STEP 8a.

lost: A concession inside the conclusion has to be moved out into a separate sentence after the whole conditional.
fix: Same as the modifier-block relation fix above.

lost: There is no first person plural or generic 'we'; only ME and YOU exist.
fix: Head particle US (writer plus others); generic people can stay ALL person.

lost: 'Hardly' is a hedged near-negation; plain NOT makes a stronger claim than Darwin does.
fix: Degree particle BARELY (and ALMOST) in the degree slot.

lost: The long suspended sentence that delays its verdict to the end is broken into seven short statements.
fix: none: out of scope

lost: A section heading has no construct; it must be faked as a statement.
fix: Opener HEAD for titles and headings (takes a bare phrase).

lost: Generic indefinite reference (any ham meant for baking) can only be written with ALL, and the later 'it' (this ham) is not distinguished from the kind.
fix: Quantifier-slot particle GENERIC.

lost: Obligation or recommendation has no particle and is carried by a root predicate over a block.
fix: Modal slot: MUST, MAY, CAN.

source: for at least 12 hours ... for nearly 4 hours ... a much longer time
lost: There is no role for duration, so WHEN 12 hour can decode as a clock time.
fix: Role SPAN for how long (distinct from WHEN).

lost: A lower bound on a number cannot be marked; the bare number reads as exactly 12, or needs a second sentence with a negated comparison.
fix: Number modifiers before a number: ATLEAST, ATMOST, ABOUT.

lost: Approximation from below is dropped; the cook is told exactly four hours.
fix: Number modifier ABOUT (and ALMOST).

lost: 'Any' means if there are some; ALL place suggests they exist.
fix: Quantifier ANY (free choice, no existence implied).

source: of sufficient thickness all over to keep the gravy in
lost: Enough-of-a-property-for-a-result has no form and is turned into a cause statement.
fix: Degree particle ENOUGH paired with a FOR block (and TOO).

source: Take off the crust, and skin
lost: Two objects of one verb need two sentences.
fix: Phrase coordinator AND.

source: the same as for boiled ham
lost: Likeness to another procedure is only expressible by stretching THAN with a root meaning same.
fix: State in the spec that THAN also marks the standard for same/similar, or add role LIKE.

lost: 'Many' is not a quantifier, so the size of the group holding the opinion rides on a KIND modifier.
fix: Quantifier MANY.

source: far superior ... a much longer time
lost: The size of the difference in a comparison cannot be marked.
fix: Degree slot before the comparing predicate (VERY, SLIGHT).

source: cuts fuller of gravy and has a finer flavour
lost: A comparative with no stated standard cannot be written; without a THAN phrase the predicate reads as plain 'full', so the standard must be supplied each time.
fix: Degree particle MORE, usable without THAN.

source: as it cuts fuller..., and has a finer flavour, besides keeping...
lost: Three joined reasons need a repeated CAUSE role, whose meaning the spec does not define, and 'besides' (an extra reason) is flattened.
fix: AND between blocks; state that a repeated role is not allowed or means conjunction.

source: Wipe it dry, trim away..., cover it
lost: A recipe instruction to any reader is not a request to a present party; REQUEST with YOU personalises it.
fix: Opener INSTRUCT (procedure step, no specific addressee).

lost: A forward pointer to a run of sentences cannot be made, as STEP names one sentence.
fix: Allow STEP n TO m for a range.

source: between the try and except keywords
lost: Position between two landmarks has no role and is rebuilt with FROM and TO.
fix: Role BETWEEN, or a small set of relation roles (BEFORE, AFTER, BETWEEN).

source: the except clause is skipped and execution of the try statement is finished
lost: Two results of one condition cannot share a block, so the condition is written twice.
fix: AND block block.

lost: This conditional only applies inside the case opened by the previous sentence (an exception occurred), and nothing marks that a sentence continues inside an earlier condition.
fix: Relation UNDER label: this sentence holds within the condition or supposition of sentence n.

source: the except clause is executed, and then execution continues
lost: Order of two events inside one result block cannot be marked; SEQUENCE works only between sentences.
fix: Roles BEFORE and AFTER taking a block or phrase.

source: named after the except keyword ... continues after the try/except block
lost: 'After' as position in text or in time has no role; it needs a relative clause with a root meaning follow.
fix: Roles BEFORE and AFTER.

lost: Saying that a thing belongs to a class has no clear form, since the spec shows only property predicates and BE only inside DEFINE.
fix: Allow BE as a general predicate: BE THEME x KIND-phrase, or state that a full phrase may be the predicate.

lost: The split between a title and the body of a post has no construct beyond an ad hoc label.
fix: Opener HEAD.

source: this code ... this is the caller
lost: Pointing at an attached block of text needs a handle plus a separate DEFINE sentence.
fix: Allow NAMED handle BE «...» inside a phrase.

lost: The spec does not say that « » keeps line breaks and indentation, and in this code the indentation is the structure.
fix: State that « » is verbatim including whitespace and newlines.

lost: The source breaks off mid-line and there is no way to mark quoted text as cut off.
fix: Marker CUT after a quotation.

lost: The logic sub-language cannot restate the code (no assignment, no 'and', no call on an object), so the code can only be quoted, not reasoned about.
fix: none: out of scope (or add SET and AND to the logic statements).

lost: A proportion (most of) is not a quantifier and is written as a kind of part.
fix: Quantifier MOST.

source: south of western Washington ... south of Seattle ... south of WA/OR border
lost: A direction relative to a landmark has no form; the natural 'south OF X' decodes as the southern part of X, the opposite of the claim.
fix: Linker REL for relational roots (south REL X = south of X), keeping OF for owner and whole.

source: dives southwards ... spreads northwards into Washington
lost: Direction of motion and the place reached both use TO.
fix: Role TOWARD for direction.

source: mainly remain confined south of Seattle ... mainly Friday AM
lost: 'Mainly' (mostly, not exclusively) has no focus particle; leaving it out or using ONLY overstates the forecast.
fix: Focus particle MAINLY.

source: and especially south of WA/OR border
lost: 'Especially' ranks one place above another within the same claim; sentence EMPHASIS on a repeated sentence only approximates it, and EVEN means the wrong thing.
fix: Focus particle MAINLY or ESPECIALLY before the phrase.

source: in the Cascade Valleys and gaps ... North Bend and Enumclaw
lost: Two places in one phrase need duplicate sentences, which turns one joint probability into two separate claims.
fix: Phrase coordinator AND.

lost: A numeric range is not a head type and survives only as quoted notation or a FROM/TO construction.
fix: Number range as a head: n TO m in the number slot.

lost: Approximation of a number or value cannot be marked.
fix: Number modifier ABOUT.

source: by Thursday into Friday ... Saturday into next week
lost: Start-no-later-than and lasting-through are not distinguished; two WHEN phrases or FROM/TO borrowed from space are the only means.
fix: Roles SINCE and UNTIL (time span ends), plus BY for a deadline.

lost: The source reports a change (becoming drier) and the aspect list has nothing for the start of a state.
fix: Aspect particle BEGIN (entering a state or action).

lost: Repetition of an earlier event has no marker.
fix: Aspect particle AGAIN.

source: with some uncertainty into the exact positioning and depth
lost: Doubt about one part of a claim cannot be scoped; strength applies to a whole sentence, so new negated sentences are needed and 'some' is dropped.
fix: Allow strength particles in the focus slot before a phrase.

source: NBM probabilities of gusts over 30 MPH ... around 30-60%
lost: A numeric probability does not fit the three strength words and has to be a claim about a chance, wrapped in a say-clause.
fix: Allow a number or range in the strength slot (LIKELY «0.3-0.6»).

lost: Continuation of a state (still, remain) has no aspect and relies on a root verb.
fix: Aspect particle STILL.

source: Theorem. There are infinitely many prime numbers.
lost: A claim stated first and proved after fits no opener: it is not given, not yet derived, not assumed and not a plan.
fix: Opener CLAIM (asserted; support follows), or let DERIVED cite later labels.

source: Suppose ... Hence there are infinitely many primes
lost: Nothing marks which sentences lie inside the supposition and where it is dropped, so 'q is a prime not on the list' reads as a plain derived fact.
fix: Relation UNDER label for sentences inside a supposition; the first DERIVED without it is outside.

lost: ONLY attaches to phrases, not to a predicate, so 'only finite' cannot be said.
fix: Allow the focus slot before the predicate.

lost: NAMED binds one handle; naming an indexed family of unknown size needs quoted notation.
fix: Indexed handle: P OF I, with EACH I IN P.

source: Since N > 1, some prime q divides N
lost: The step rests on one earlier line plus a known fact, but an opener is either DERIVED or RECALLED, so the known fact must be written out as an extra sentence.
fix: Let DERIVED cite the word RECALLED alongside labels.

lost: A cardinality used as a quantifier must be recast as a property of the count.
fix: Allow a root in the quantifier slot after a marker (COUNT infinite prime).

lost: No inclusive 'we' for writer and reader.
fix: Head particle US.

summary: The spec is strong at the sentence level (openers, relations, DERIVED with labels, handles, IF with an else block, EACH for the proof) and weak inside the clause. The most frequent gap by far is coordination: with no AND for phrases or blocks, every list, joint condition and double result is split or nested, and in the forecast this changes the claims. Next come degree and approximation (very, far, enough, at least, nearly, around, hardly, mainly), then modality inside clauses, time relations and duration (before, after, for how long, by, until), and spatial relations, where 'south OF X' decodes to the wrong meaning. The scope of a supposition or condition across sentences is unmarked, which matters in the proof and the documentation. I used GIVEN, IF, KIND, NAMED handles, SEQUENCE, ADD, CAUSE and THAN most; I never used OR, INSTEAD, ALSO, EVEN, SURPRISE, POLITE, REGRET, HABIT, WHILE or RETURN, and LIKELY not at all. Two points are spec ambiguities, not gaps: the direction of CONCEDE and whether « » keeps whitespace.
